title: Moon Tower Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Check out the prime Seaside, Florida location home Moon Tower with great open porches and a tower with incredible Seaside roof top and sunset views. Just 5 minute walk to beach and 3 houses to the pool!
description_expanded: Description776 FOREST STREETKING, QUEEN, ONE TWIN BUNK (Sleeps 6)Welcome to Moon Tower | Seaside, Florida on 30AWelcome to Moon Tower, a popular family-friendly Seaside vacation home perfectly positioned in one of the community’s most desirable locations. Just a 5-minute walk to the beach and only three homes from the West Side Pool, this coastal retreat offers comfort, charm, and unforgettable views. With three bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a one-of-a-kind open-air tower, Moon Tower is designed for relaxed gatherings and classic Seaside living.Prime West Side Seaside LocationLocated in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Moon Tower places you within easy walking distance of the beach, pools, and Seaside’s town center. Spend your days on the sugar-white sand, stroll to local shops and dining, or enjoy Seaside’s beloved community events—all just steps from your front door.Inviting Porches & Coastal Outdoor LivingThe home’s vibrant coastal teal exterior welcomes you with generous open-air porches that span the full length of the home on both levels. The first-floor porch features Adirondack chairs and a bench swing, making it the perfect place for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or relaxed evenings with music and conversation. This outdoor space also works beautifully for grilling and casual gatherings after beach days.Upstairs, a large shared porch with rocking chairs and a bench swing offers another inviting spot to unwind with a book or enjoy an evening nightcap under the Seaside sky.Spacious Living & Gathering AreasInside, the spacious living room offers ample seating with two sofas and two club chairs, making it ideal for family time or entertaining friends. A large mounted Plasma TV creates the perfect setup for movie nights after long days in the sun.Adjacent to the living area, the dining space features a farmhouse table that comfortably seats eight, perfect for shared meals and memorable conversations. The fully equipped kitchen includes a two-door refrigerator, four-burner stove, microwave, coffee maker, breakfast bar seating for three, and plenty of cabinet storage—everything needed for easy home-cooked meals or casual snacks and wine gatherings. A full bathroom with a walk-in shower is also conveniently located on the first floor.Comfortable Upstairs BedroomsUpstairs, you’ll find three inviting bedrooms designed for rest and relaxation.The king primary suite features its own Plasma TV, a private en-suite bathroom, and access to a spacious furnished balcony.The queen bedroom includes a Plasma TV and easy access to a shared full bathroom.The bunk room offers two custom-built twin beds, making it a perfect space for kids or younger guests.The shared upstairs bathroom includes a tub and shower combination, ideal for families.Iconic Tower with Panoramic Seaside ViewsThe highlight of Moon Tower awaits at the top of the home. A ship’s ladder leads to the enclosed and open-air tower, a truly special Seaside feature. Inside, bar seating for two offers sweeping views of the town, while the covered open-air deck provides additional bar seating for two and breathtaking panoramic views of Seaside. This elevated retreat is the ultimate spot to watch the sunset, enjoy evening breezes, and take in the charm of this iconic 30A community.A Seaside Favorite for Families & FriendsWith its unbeatable West Side location, multiple porches, spacious layout, and unforgettable tower views, Moon Tower is a standout choice for families and groups looking to experience the best of Seaside, Florida. Relax, reconnect, and soak in the views—this is Seaside living at its finest.Moon Tower is the ideal place for your next beach vacation. Need extra space? The nearby guest house, Heavy Water sleeps four more guests, making this property perfect for larger groups. Book your stay at Moon Tower today and experience the charm and beauty of Seaside for yourself!*5 night minimum stay Spring & Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES1,652 square feetOnly 352 yards (5-minute walk) to the beachPrivate Seaside residential beach access: Pensacola Pavilion — one of the largest private residential beaches on 30ALocation: Just three houses from the West End family poolOutdoor amenities: Charcoal grill (private to Moon Tower) and outdoor showerLaundry: Full-size stackable washer & dryerCommunity amenities access: Three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote: Two beach towels, one bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (available for pick-up at Seaside Transit Authority)Parking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes are issued. Golf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permit.Personalized service: Starter amenities provided for a comfortable arrivalNo pets allowed
